Source: ServUO (SeriousFun build): Services/LootGeneration (ItemPropertyInfo, RunicReforging, Imbuing), Config/Loot.cfg, Abilities/SlayerGroup.cs, Items/Equipment GetProperties. Numbers and rules only.

Generation.Note: RunicReforging.GenerateRandomItem: base budget from the creature, rolled up by a luck-weighted percent; few props at low budget, 4-10 strong props from 550 up. Each property: a random id from the item type's loot list (not one it has), value Scale(min, max, perclow, perchigh) rounded to its step, lowered until it fits the budget; the budget pays weight / max x value.
Generation.PrefixChance: budget >= Random(2700) (named prefixes and suffixes aren't migrated: plain random properties instead)

Disadvantages.Note: TryApplyRandomDisadvantage: Lesser items 5% (one of Prized, Antique, Unwieldly x2, Cursed x2, Massive x2; jewels without the last two), Greater 25% (75%: one of Prized, Antique, Unwieldly x2, Massive x2; else 25%/50%: Prized; Antique or Brittle (+150 budget); Cursed); Major and up as Greater; MajorArtifact jewels always Antique (75%) or Cursed. Each gives 100 budget for up to 5 more properties.

Specials.Note: 1000: a random slayer (BaseRunicTool.GetRandomSlayer: one of the first 6 groups, 10% its super slayer); 1001-1005: a random skill bonus from JewelSkills not already on it

Validation.Note: ItemPropertyInfo.ValidateProperty: which properties an item may take besides its type's loot list
Validation.ExcludedNote: 60 velocity and 62-68 are the shard's own ranged and spell additions (custom systems wait); 200 Blood Drinker needs weapons with the bleed attack (weapon abilities aren't in the item data yet)

SkillBonusTooltip.Note: the nth skill line is 1060451 + n (~1_skillname~ +~2_val~); a skill's name is cliloc 1044060 + its id

Slayers.Note: a slayer on a weapon doubles its damage (+100%) against the creatures it names; a super slayer names its whole group
